business: Bitterroot Food Group, Inc. (Specialty Food Manufacturing & Co-Packing)

redFlags: Commodity hedging loss - non-recurring: Unsupported. Account 6730 posts a loss in all 36 months. Hedging is a permanent feature of a business that buys agricultural inputs on floating prices, and the cost of the programme is an operating cost.

Inventory obsolescence write-off - one-time: Largely unsupported. Write-offs recur every month. Only the $41,000 November 2025 spike above the trailing run rate is genuinely unusual; the remaining $83,000 is normal shrink and short-code loss.
Customer concentration: Largest customer, Ravenna Foods Inc., is 23.4% of FY2025 revenue; top 5 are 84.2%.
yellowFlags: Family members on payroll: Partially supportable. Three family members are on payroll; two hold no operating role and their $119,000 of combined compensation is a genuine add-back. The third runs the co-packing schedule and must be replaced.
SQF food-safety certification project: Fully supportable. Initial SQF certification is a discrete project, and the ledger shows activity only in February and May 2025.

Unrecorded accrued PTO liability (buyer adjustment): Buyer-identified downward adjustment of $88,000. Account 2200 shows no movement consistent with a PTO accrual, so earned but untaken leave is being expensed only when taken. Run-rate EBITDA must absorb the accrual.

Seasonality and net working capital swing: FY2025 monthly EBITDA ranges from $48,247 to $187,721; cash ranges from $11,327,571 to $16,867,169. The NWC peg must be set on a 12-month average, not a period-end snapshot.
greenFlags: Verified TTM Revenue of $14.33M across VDR financials.
